prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Companion Preview Stage Redesign: Redesign the companion selection view into an interactive preview stage where users can see pet animations and desktop behaviors live before adopting.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Preview Your Desktop Companion", "body": "See how your pet moves and interacts on your desktop before welcoming them home."}}
1: [sign_in, copy] Account Pet Recovery & Persistence Assurance Copy: Update the sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly reassure users that signing in preserves saved pets and prevents profile resets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Save & Sync Your Pets", "body": "Your account keeps your custom desktop companions safe across sessions and prevents profile resets."}}
2: [choose_path, redesign] Carousel Path Selection Overview Redesign: Redesign path selection into a carousel view comparing instant starter companions with custom photo-generated pets.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "carousel", "headline": "Choose Your Pet Creation Path", "body": "Browse instant pre-made pets or create a custom pet from your own photos."}}
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Launch Live Progress Status Info: Display detailed progress indicators and estimated loading time on the waiting screen while initializing the desktop engine.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Setting up desktop display overlays and pet physics engine..."}}
4: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Pet Quality Diagnostic Verification Flow: Add an instant preview checklist and retry option during photo upload to catch bad generation before final adoption.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Photo lighting and clarity check complete"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Preview & Adjust Photo", "action": "open_tip"}]}}
5: [sign_in, hint] Multi-Account Pet Restoration Sign-In Hint: Add a prominent hint under sign-in buttons encouraging users to log into their original account to recover lost pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Logging in with your original account automatically restores your saved desktop pets."}}
6: [adoption, new_screen] Interactive Companion Trait Customizer Screen: Insert a new `new_trait_customizer` screen before the adoption certificate to allow customizing companion traits and sound effects.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_trait_customizer", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_trait_customizer": {"headline": "Customize Pet Behavior", "body": "Select your companion's sound effects, personality traits, and desktop movement style.", "layout": "centered"}}
7: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Render & Overlay Placement Status Info: Show detailed desktop overlay placement status and readiness notification options during launch initialization.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Checking screen resolution and desktop window permissions..."}}
8: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Clarity & Lighting Quality Hint: Provide guidance hints on the photo upload screen explaining photo quality requirements for accurate pet model generation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "For best results, upload a well-lit photo showing your pet facing directly toward the camera."}}
9: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Certificate Sign-In Sequence Reorder: Move sign-in after pet adoption certificate creation so users pick and personalize their pet before creating an account.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the pick a friend view into an interactive stage maintains the step's core job within onboarding limits.
Updating sign-in copy to emphasize pet persistence is an allowed copy change within onboarding.
Carousel layout redesign for path selection retains both options (adopting and custom creation) and complies with onboarding rules.
Adding detailed progress and estimated wait time during engine initialization reflects a real wait and complies with fair design rules.
Adding diagnostic checklist components and preview/adjust actions to photo upload enhances the existing step without breaking rules.
Adding sign-in recovery hints is an acceptable onboarding copy update.
Inserting a new trait customizer screen into onboarding order while retaining all mandatory steps is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.
Adding status hints and notifications during the waiting screen wait is permissible.
Adding photo clarity guidance hints to photo upload complies with all onboarding rules.
Reordering sign-in to after the adoption certificate is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.
